name: TensoRF
definition: A factorized tensorial radiance field that represents continuous volume density ($σ$) and view-dependent color ($c$) using tensor factorization (CP or VM) to achieve compact modeling and fast reconstruction.
summary: TensoRF is a volume rendering method that replaces NeRF's implicit MLPs with factorized 4D tensor grids, enabling significantly faster training and smaller model sizes while maintaining high rendering quality.
